description: LetsBot lets you manage your WhatsApp business conversations directly from ChatGPT. Send and receive messages, manage contacts and labels, use AI-powered auto-replies, and integrate with Salla & Zid e-commerce platforms. Perfect for businesses using WhatsApp for customer support and sales.
